subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 03/10] mountd: answer requests the kernel rejects on the netlink downcall

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the mountd service to handle rejected requests from the kernel when processing export requests via netlink downcalls. The kernel rejects certain requests, causing pending requests to be dropped and clients to hang on lookups. The patch resubmits rejected requests one at a time, answers negative for refused entries, and logs size failures. It also separates the kernel's errno from libnl errors in cache_nl_set_reqs().
